ache.title: Free code, treasure chest, and a P2W side door
ache.note: Spooky season, and the free stuff (the ‘pokeween24’ code, the Darkrai event) shares one ‘F2P & P2W’ guide with the paid track. That’s how event cycles work: free rewards walk you right up to the paid ones, and the treasure chest challenge keeps you logging in. ‘Don’t miss out’, he says. You can.
watch: free and paid rewards side by side
a treasure chest challenge to grind
a reward cycle on a timer
ache.tip: Grab free rewards only if you’d play anyway, then close the event tab. The paid half isn’t part of the deal.
lines: free candy, then the shop door opens
scariest thing this halloween: the shop
